summary.text: C.D. Reynolds, an independent candidate for Rhode Island governor, lost the November 3, 2026 election to Helena Foulkes.
Reynolds qualified for the November ballot alongside independents Ken Block and Jasjit Gotra, and Wikipedia describes Reynolds as a perennial candidate.
Reynolds received 0.6% of the vote to Foulkes’s 57.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Rhode Island primary election results: Foulkes and Morales topple incumbents
